text: Slide the CNC door to the open position.
Yield at the occupied tray while the operator stamps the blank.
Resume when the operator has withdrawn her hand.
Approach the aluminum blank at the shared tray.
Close the gripper on the blank.
Lift the blank from the tray.
Carry the blank into the vise.
Lower the blank toward the two parallels.
Turn the over-center cam to close the vise jaws.
Back the gripper out of the vise.
Verify that both jaws load the workpiece.
